grades: Sophomores, juniors and seniors in high school
notes: The page does not say what travel papers are needed, so ask the Zoo. The trip is 3 days on land and 3 on the water, weather permitting. Field station is on Andros Island, Bahamas.
name: Oceans and You: Bahamas Field Study (Teen Conservation Travel)
city: Columbus, OH (trip to Andros Island, Bahamas)
what_you_do: An 8-day trip to the Forfar Field Station in the Bahamas with Zoo staff. You study the sea and how to protect it. You snorkel, explore tide pools, and learn about climate change, plastics and jobs in conservation.
who_can_apply: High school sophomores, juniors or seniors who like marine science. You must go to an info session and fill out a form.
deadline_text: Apply by November 22, 2026. Info sessions: in person Nov. 11, 2026 and virtual Nov. 12, 2026 (6:30 to 7:30 p.m.). The Zoo tells students if they were selected by December 4, 2026.
how_to_apply: Go to an info session. Fill out the interest form. Then fill out the Apply for the Program form linked on the page.
